meaning:
ἀπο-ψύχω
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:18 * ;]
1. to breathe out life, expire (Thue.; LXX, l.with).
2. to leave off breathing, faint (Hom., Od., xxiv, 348): before ἀπό, Luk.21:26.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
